Ollama v0.32.10-rc0: nn: speed up prefill on double-scale nvfp4 models
items.summary: ModelOpt checkpoints apply a float32 global scale to every projection output on top of the per-group quantization scales. Running the multiply and the cast back to the activation dtype as separate eager ops costs an extra kernel launch and a materialized intermediate per projection. Compile the multiply and cast into one kernel.
